did.abstract: One photograph album containing images of the Deepdale Golf Club course and clubhouse (interior and exterior), dating from circa 1955. The course is located in Manhasset, New York, on the north shore of Long Island. The album includes one photograph of President Dwight D. Eisenhower on the course. The album was created by Haynes Provost Studios.

acqinfo.head: Immediate Source of Acquisition
acqinfo.p: Gift of James F. Carr, 1968. The item's provenance was unknown until 2026. It was first formally accessioned in 1998.

arrangement.head: Arrangement
arrangement.p: This collection consists of a single volume.

bioghist.head: Historical note
bioghist.p: The Deepdale Golf Club was established by William K. Vanderbilt II in 1924. It was constructed on the property of his summer home ("Lake Success") in Manhasset, New York, on the north shore of Long Island. It was designed by Charles Blair Macdonald, Seth Raynor, and Charles Banks. Due to the construction of the Long Island Expressway in 1954, the course was reestablished on the nearby W.R. Grace estate by Dick Wilson. The Grace Mansion served as the new clubhouse, and the course was reopened in 1955.
